user.description: On the TV, turn on Settings > Backup & restore > Allow control from other apps.

data_description.host: IP address of the TV (or its .local name).
data_description.port: Port of the Arc Launcher API; 47474 unless you changed it.

zeroconf_confirm.description: Add {name} ({host})? The next step shows a code on the TV.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again with {name}
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts Home Assistant, for example because control from other apps was turned off. Make sure it is turned on; the next step shows a new code on the TV.

pair.title: Enter the code
pair.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown on {name}. The code is valid for 2 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the TV. Is it on, with Arc Launcher as the home app?
error.invalid_host: Use an IP address or a .local name.
error.not_arc_launcher: This is not an Arc Launcher TV.
error.control_disabled: Turn on Allow control from other apps on the TV (Settings > Backup & restore).
error.invalid_code: Wrong code. Check the code on the TV.
error.pairing_busy: The TV is already waiting for another pairing code. Wait 2 minutes and try again.
error.pairing_blocked: Too many wrong codes. Pairing is blocked for a while; try again later.
error.pairing_restarted: The code expired. The TV now shows a new code.

abort.not_arc_launcher: This is not an Arc Launcher TV.
abort.wrong_device: That code belongs to a different TV.

restore_layout.name: Restore layout
restore_layout.description: Applies an Arc Launcher settings file to one or more TVs, from a file in the config folder or from another TV.

device_id.name: TVs
device_id.description: The TVs that get the layout.

file.name: File
file.description: Settings file, relative to the Home Assistant config folder.

from_device.name: From TV
from_device.description: Copy the current layout of this TV instead of using a file.
